+def test_build_doc_returns_role_documentation():
+    role = RoleMixin()
+    entry_points = {
+        'main': {'short_description': 'Main entry point'},
+        'setup': {'short_description': 'Setup entry point'},
+    }
+
+    fqcn, doc = role._build_doc('example', '/roles/example', 'acme.tools', entry_points, 'setup')
+
+    assert fqcn == 'acme.tools.example'
+    assert doc == {
+        'path': '/roles/example',
+        'collection': 'acme.tools',
+        'entry_points': {'setup': entry_points['setup']},
+    }
+    assert doc['entry_points']['setup'] is entry_points['setup']
+    assert set(entry_points) == {'main', 'setup'}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('entry_points, filter_name', [({}, None), ({'main': {}}, 'setup')])
+def test_build_doc_omits_empty_or_unmatched_entry_points(entry_points, filter_name):
+    fqcn, doc = RoleMixin()._build_doc('example', '/roles/example', '', entry_points, filter_name)
+
+    assert fqcn == 'example'
+    assert doc is None
